key_features: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Gel Cream Fragrance Free with Hyaluronic Acid instantly delivers 6x more* hydration (*vs. untreated skin). Lightweight, non-greasy gel cream absorbs quickly to leave skin feeling nourished, soft, and hydrated all day.

Ideal for normal to dry skin and gentle enough for sensitive or acne-prone skin, this dermatologist-tested moisturizer delivers 48 hours of hydration and strengthens the skin’s natural moisture barrier after just one use.
Formulated with hyaluronic acid, electrolytes, and Natural Moisturizing Factors like amino acids to attract and retain water, helping restore balance and promote supple, healthy-looking skin.

This non-comedogenic, fragrance-free, paraben-free, and phthalate-free facial moisturizer absorbs quickly and provides a smooth, velvety finish. Ideal for daily use and suitable for both women and men.
Complete your skincare routine with this dermatologist-tested, hydrating gel cream. Apply evenly to face and neck after cleansing for plumper-feeling, glowing, and refreshed skin anytime, anywhere.
review_summary: Neutrogena Hydro Boost Hyaluronic Acid Gel Cream Fragrance Free provides long-lasting hydration for nourished, dewy skin. This dermatologist-tested moisturizer is ideal for normal to dry skin and clinically proven to be gentle enough for sensitive skin. The lightweight, water-like gel cream absorbs quickly to leave skin feeling soft, refreshed, and supple. Formulated with hyaluronic acid—a dermatologist-recommended hydrator that binds to water and locks in moisture—plus Natural Moisturizing Factors including amino acids and electrolytes to help restore the skin’s moisture balance and strengthen its barrier. The non-comedogenic, fragrance-free formula is also free from dyes, parabens, and phthalates, making it suitable for acne-prone or sensitive skin. Clinically proven to deliver 48 hours of hydration, this travel-size face cream keeps skin looking plump, glowing, and healthy. Apply daily to face and neck after cleansing as part of your skincare routine.
